inside-main-floor.anchorNote: the room frame's pixel for grid tile (0,0)'s top-left corner (same convention as home-dojo room_*.png)
inside-main-floor.note: ONE wide scrolling room. Draw order: floor, walls, props, then wall-decal sprites and y-sorted sprites and characters sorted by sortRow, then foreground ABOVE the characters. floor: ground: lobby tile, blue mats, big red square with the school logo, thresholds, front-door mat, the seating decks and steps, the red gear-bag box base. Draw first, at depth 0. | walls: the north wall with its wall art, the side wall strips, the back-wall drywall. Nothing above the drywall. Draw above floor. | props: wall-hugging furniture that never moves: the creed boards, flag, mural frames, the gear shelf and crash mats. Under every character. | foreground: the front wall (curb, door posts, door header, open door leaves): the one FULL-FRAME layer drawn ABOVE characters, so a student walking in or out passes behind it. The seat backs and the bag tops are foreground SPRITES (see foregroundSprites), because each has its own sortRow.
